note: THE pin of the toolchain, in one place. Consumers: attempt.py (HOLDIR defaults to hol_dir_mac; local runs refuse another commit), pod/client.py (a pod at another commit is refused), pod/runner.py (HOL at hol_dir_pod), pod/setup-pod.sh + push.sh (the pod is built at these tags), build-base.sh and regen-key.sh (HOL at hol_dir_mac unless HOLDIR is set; any other commit refused). To move the package: change this file, build HOL at it (Mac and pod), rebuild the bases, re-run the controls, freeze again.

previous.why_moved: the released CakeML compiler binary was built with trindemossen-2-v10; the CakeML agent found aligning on -v9 not cheap and the frozen checker's -v10 kernel verdicts equal to the -v9 ones on all 52 inputs (hol4/delta3/cakeml/WORKLOG.md); the operator's decision: move everything to -v10
